items.title: 27.4.4 Lipids ki ghizai aur hayatiyati ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the importance of lipids (PDF 171-172).

items: Lipids ka bara kaam jaandaron mein tawanai ka asal zakheera hona hai. Yeh fi gram carbohydrates se zyada tawanai dete hain, kyunke carbon dioxide aur paani mein oxidise hone par zyada hararat chhorte hain.
Lipids charbi mein ghulne wale vitamins A, D, E aur K ke solvent hain aur aanton mein in ke jazb aur khoon mein naql mein madad dete hain; yeh vitamins thori sehatmand charbi ke saath khane chahiye.
Charbi non-polar hone ki wajah se jism ko hararat ke nuqsan se bachati hai. (Kitab paani aur bijli se insulation ka bhi zikr karti hai.)

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? Hibernation
blocks.text: Polar bear, reptiles aur amphibians jaise jaanwar hibernation se pehle zaid charbi jama karte hain. Hibernation mein yeh khurak ki kami ke dauran tawanai bachane ke liye metabolism ki raftaar, jism ka darja hararat, dil ki dharkan aur saans bohat kam kar dete hain. Charbi glycogen se zyada gathi tawanai ka zariya hai, is liye yeh bohat kam tawanai kharch karte hue jama charbi mo'assar taur par use kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Lipids paani mein kyun nahi ghulte?
blocks.explanation: In ki lambi hydrocarbon zanjeerein non-polar (hydrophobic) hain aur paani ke molecules se hydrogen bonds nahi bana saktin.

blocks.prompt: Insani jism mein lipids ke teen bare kaam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi teen: tawanai ka zakheera; insulation aur aaza ki hifazat; cell jhilliyon ka hissa (phospholipids); charbi mein ghulne wale vitamins ka solvent; hormones (steroids).

blocks.prompt: Kaun se lipids mein fatty acids hote hain aur kaun se mein nahi? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Fatty acids wale: triglycerides (charbi aur teil), waxes aur phospholipids. Fatty acids ke baghair: steroids (cholesterol) aur terpenes (limonene).

blocks.prompt: Nabati teil aur banaspati ghee dono triglycerides hain. Banawat ka bara farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Nabati teil mein zyada tar unsaturated fatty acids (C=C) hain, is liye maaye hai; banaspati ghee teil ki hydrogenation se banta hai, is liye is ke fatty acids zyada tar saturated aur yeh thos hai.

items: Lipids: sab se ameer tawanai ka zakheera; vitamins A, D, E, K le jate; insulation.
Hibernation wale jaanwar jama charbi par munhasir.
